first_accepted_patch:
--- a/counter.v
+++ b/counter.v
@@ -22,13 +22,13 @@
     always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
         if (!reset_n) begin
             val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};
-        end else begin
+        end else if (cnt_en) begin
             if (val_out >= limit_val) begin
                 val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};
             end else begin
                 val_out <= val_out + 1'b1;
             end
-        end
+        end 
     end
 
 endmodule

parsed_output.root_cause: The sequential counting logic did not account for the cnt_en input signal. As a result, the counter continued to count even when cnt_en was low, violating the specification that the count should freeze when cnt_en is 0. This caused multiple test failures, particularly in test_counter_enable_freeze.
parsed_output.patch:
--- a/rtl/counter.v
+++ b/rtl/counter.v
@@ -23,12 +23,12 @@
     always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
         if (!reset_n) begin
             val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};
-        end else begin
-            if (val_out >= limit_val) begin
+        end else if (cnt_en) begin
+            if (val_out >= limit_val) begin
                 val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};
             end else begin
                 val_out <= val_out + 1'b1;
             end
-        end
+        end
     end
 
 endmodule
